settings.heading: Find an answer fast.
settings.text: Search by keyword or browse orders, shipping, returns, products and rewards.

settings.question: Can I change my order?
settings.answer: Changes are possible for about an hour after checkout; contact us quickly and we will try to catch it.

settings.question: Can I use two discount codes?
settings.answer: Only one code applies per order. The welcome code works on a first purchase.

settings.question: What does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Orders of $30 or more ship free within the contiguous US; below that, a flat $10 applies.

settings.question: When do I get a tracking link?
settings.answer: As soon as your parcel leaves the warehouse, usually within two business days.

settings.question: Where do I register my heated tool?
settings.answer: On the registration page. Registered tools carry a one-year warranty.

settings.question: Which products are vegan?
settings.answer: Every formula is vegan and cruelty-free; look for the badge on each product page.

settings.question: How do I spend my points?
settings.answer: Choose a voucher in your cart and the discount applies to the order straight away.

settings.question: Can I earn points on gift cards?
settings.answer: Gift cards do not count toward free shipping, gifts or points thresholds.

settings.heading: Get the drop before it drops
settings.message: New launches, member sales and the odd styling trick, sent once a week.
